Step 7 failed because 1/0 causes a ZeroDivisionError in Python. The error happens before the
 evaluate() function can process the expression because the tuple values are evaluated first. 
 Python’s own or operator would not evaluate the right side when the left side is already True 
 because it uses short-circuit evaluation. This shows that my evaluator evaluates both sides of 
 an expression, unlike Python’s own or operator.
